independent_review.scope: Corrected independent-control/observation reference plan and executable stricter power predicate, with unchanged numeric targets; reference/source/env qualifications and candidate execution remain separate

governance: Local proposal only; all global gate and acceptance activity is recorded solely in ExecutionStateV1.json
scope: Reproduce all 21+21+3 original internal finite-time records and establish a separate prospective numerical/new-algorithm qualification; not Calado-paper fitting

reference_set.payload_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False); parsed integer/float values retained; not an RFC 8785 claim
reference_set.dedup_rule: Only identical full effective source/input/protocol/initial/model/numerics/environment identity may share an execution; preserve every coverage relation

protocol.driver: continuous waveform, finite-time Radau; no substitution of a steady solve
protocol.contact_semantics: Original all-carrier Dirichlet; not paper mixed-minority contacts
protocol.effective_material_input: Exact nominal_request.device retained; alter only the selected absorber field

diffusivity.zero_meaning: D=0 keeps the uniform mobile-ion population and equal negative background

density.zero_meaning: c0=0 removes initial mobile inventory and fixed countercharge
density.coupling: Every c0 change updates both fixed negative background and initial mobile population

identity.current_effective_source_gap: Two of six old code pins match current files; resolve each changed file and full historical environment before treating an old artifact as exact algorithm replay

historical_four_same_grid.scope: D ratios 0, 0.2, 1, 2 only; original 61 nodes and 110 archived current samples per branch

existing_limits.mask: Only the inherited [1:] stored-current scope on both branches; original omission remains visible
existing_limits.qualification: historical four-case same-grid regression only; no full scan or new solver certification

full_record_reproduction.scope: All 45 records, full native branches and current/metric/status fields under original input/history; old stored comparisons apply at their 110 available coordinates
full_record_reproduction.coarse_reference_policy: If original finite-grid values fail reference-error requirements, keep them as historical anchors and explicitly rebaseline numerical evidence; do not force agreement by loosening gates

numerical_and_new_algorithm.scope: Comparison against independently qualified numerical references, preserving physical preparation and observations; adaptive internal steps need not match

Pmax_W_m2.additional_limit: Must also meet the tighter per-case HI uncertainty allocation

PCE_percent.requires: fixed declared incident power or mark undefined

HI_P.requires: resolved supplied power uncertainties and same definition

zero_inventory_absolute_m_minus2.scale: fixed cref*400nm = 4e18 m^-2; no division by zero

numerical_and_new_algorithm.design_basis: Retain section 14 Voc 1e-4 V, relative Jsc/FF/PCE 1e-4 and HI absolute 1e-3 targets. The J absolute floor is 6.24e-6 of the fixed q*G*400nm=160.2176634 A/m2 generation scale; Pmax floor is J floor times fixed 0.5 V; FF floor is 0.01 percentage point; PCE floor is 0.01 W/m2 at declared 1000 W/m2 Pin. These are explicit prospective engineering floors, not inferred continuum errors.
numerical_and_new_algorithm.old_gate_precedence: Exact historical four-case same-grid replay must still satisfy its own stricter J relative and HI gates; the new numerical channel cannot waive an existing gate
numerical_and_new_algorithm.not_ready_for_execution: The reviewed thresholds and corrected reference plan may freeze before physical refinement runs. Actual source/environment/control support and independent per-case reference errors are mandatory before qualified-reference use and candidate acceptance; no execution is authorized here.

error_budget.combination: Conservative sum of independently bounded spatial, temporal, solver and observable-extraction errors; no cancellation credit
error_budget.axis_initial_allocation: Four independently assessed contributions (space, integration/time, solver accuracy, observable extraction) each start with at most 1/12 of the migration allowance; legacy coupled changes receive no separate per-axis credit
error_budget.HI_resolution: Require forward/reverse Pmax error intervals excluding zero; propagate interval corners and require propagated HI error <= one third of 1e-3 for the reference

weak_peak_example.use: Planning estimate only; actual acceptance uses nonlinear interval propagation; do not lower a floor to make the denominator resolved
weak_peak_example.exact_common_power_formula: e=B*f^2/(f+r+B*f), B=0.001/3; unequal uncertainties use exact interval corners

error_budget.rounding: Captured binary JSON values are historical stored outputs, not a numerical-error certificate

required_power_precondition.required_for: Every record and every qualified numerical reference before comparison eligibility; generic Pmax checks are necessary but insufficient
required_power_precondition.input: Actual forward/reverse powers and independently justified absolute power uncertainties, all W/m2; absent uncertainties remain unknown
all_required: Forward and reverse denominator intervals both exclude zero
Source, environment and uncertainty-evidence qualification independently verified
required_power_precondition.failure: Any false/unknown predicate blocks reference use and candidate acceptance; no scalar HI match substitutes

error_budget.legacy_joint_evidence: The old sample-count ladder changes restart placement, internal step caps and interval displacement extraction together; it is one joint diagnostic and never three independent bounds
error_budget.freeze_vs_qualification: Freeze numeric thresholds and this reviewed reference plan before generating candidate outputs. Actual reference error/source/environment evidence is then required before qualified-reference use and candidate acceptance; this task authorizes no simulation.

source_audit.restarts: sweep() calls advance() for every requested voltage point; each nonzero segment starts a new solve
source_audit.ramp_cap: duration/20 per adjacent requested-sample interval; max_nfev=100000 per solve
source_audit.hold_cap: _integrate_step uses the hold/subdivision duration/20, max_nfev=100000, max_bisect=10, with recorded numerical/radiative/BDF fallbacks; a smaller cap alone is not a branch certificate
source_audit.current: At a point, conduction is evaluated at the endpoint, displacement uses epsilon*(E_end-E_prev)/duration with the prior point/dwell state; it is not automatically an instantaneous ramp current
source_audit.dense_output: run_transient passes dense_output=False; no decoupled dense-output reference driver exists

legacy_joint_refinement.divisor80_warning: 80 was a prospective unsupported setting; current code hardcodes 20. Even at fixed 80, changing 111/221/441 points changes interval seconds and restart/current definitions together.

actions: Verify pinned inputs/curves and exact physical history
Apply the per-record executable power-error predicate; missing evidence stays unknown
Implement and independently check decoupled controls, interpolation/derivatives and event-side current under a separate authorized task before reference generation

control_restart_grid.physical_phase_boundaries: The seven phase starts/ends listed in phase_profiles
control_restart_grid.ramp_restart_formula: phase_start + j*phase_duration/440 for integer j=0..440, with the same grid for every observation request and every max-step/solver refinement level
control_restart_grid.hold_restart_rule: One fixed control interval per hold phase, ending at its physical event boundary
control_restart_grid.local_time_origin: 0 at each fixed control interval; physical time=interval_start+local_time; carry the final physical state without an output-driven reset or new initialization
control_restart_grid.observation_independence: 111/221/441 or additional qualified observation points never alter this control grid
control_restart_grid.basis: Fix the existing 441-point peak-reference control cadence once; do not reinterpret a changing n_points value as independent temporal refinement

future_decoupled_reference_driver.max_step_rule: Use the literal seconds in the selected common refinement level for every integration. These fixed numbers were chosen once from the source hold caps and legacy 441-point ramp intervals; they are independent of the requested observation count.
future_decoupled_reference_driver.work_cap_rationale: 100000 is the existing per-attempt RHS cap. Apply that fixed cap to each declared control interval; 44000000 is only the aggregate branch ceiling over the 440 frozen intervals. The 600 s wall and RSS caps still stop first. Old automatic bisection/radiative/BDF fallback is not silently inherited; any fallback must be explicitly recorded and qualified.

observation_grids.voltage_axis: Uniform -1..1.2 V forward and reverse, with exact phase time map
observation_grids.independence: All grids query the same accepted trajectory at fixed control/restart/max-step settings; requesting more observations must not change accepted steps or the physical history
observation_grids.output_kind: native endpoint or independently qualified solver dense output, with interpolation/state/derivative error evidence; display PCHIP is never counted as a new observation or accepted step

future_decoupled_reference_driver.storage: Retain control event-side states, all accepted-step times and error evidence, required native branch outputs and dense-output coefficients or an equivalent replayable representation; no omission of difficult intervals

phase1_spatial.rule: Compare conserved/weighted fields with separate interface traces; preserve the exact phase restart grid and current observable

phase1_temporal.rule: Only literal seconds caps change; the fixed 440-interval ramp control grid, hold boundaries and observation grid stay fixed; level 2 overlaps spatial runs

phase1_solver.rule: This is a joint local-error tolerance ladder. An independent nonlinear/residual or alternative-algorithm accuracy check remains necessary; do not count rtol and atol as separate axes.

phase1_observable_extraction.rule: Query the same qualified finest trajectory and explicit current definitions at the three observation grids; bracket true Pmax/Voc and bound interpolation/derivative errors. Dense interpolation without an independent bound earns no precision credit.

refinement_plan.phase1_solver_independence_gap: The present waveform path exposes no independently user-controlled nonlinear residual gate and no qualified dense-output derivative. These must be supplied and checked by an authorized future driver; current plan arithmetic does not certify them.
refinement_plan.phase1_admission: Require independently justified conservative bounds for all four contributions and the stricter per-case power predicate; contraction or repeatability alone is not a certificate

phase2_full_matrix.settings: Qualified common base plus adjacent space/time/solver checks for each otherwise untested case; observation grids reuse a qualified trajectory
phase2_full_matrix.reuse: Only exact full identity intersections; retain all 45 coverage relations
phase2_full_matrix.rule: Sentinels do not certify other coordinates; insufficient error bounds or coupled axes remain unresolved within the initial cap, with further work requiring a separately reviewed bounded plan

refinement_plan.bounded_failure: Preserve first failure, unstarted work and unsupported controls; no automatic larger budgets or relaxed numeric limits

resource_proposal.derivation: The corrected decoupled plan has 39 spatial plus 26 time-cap plus 26 solver integrations; observation refinements reuse accepted trajectories. Current legacy sampling is joint and earns no independent credit. Existing historical costs remain context only; all caps are stop rules, not predictions or execution authorization.
resource_proposal.scheduling: Correctness phase is not a performance claim. No three-repeat performance requirement added to expensive science runs.

first_point_contract.historical: All archived stored-current curves omit first sample; 90 branch-start currents have no historical array reference
first_point_contract.new_output: Retain end-dwell and event-side states, input derivatives, and explicit instantaneous ramp-side current; also retain separately labeled legacy interval endpoint current if comparing historical arrays
first_point_contract.do_not_substitute: A finite difference across the light switch or the full dwell is not the ramp-start instantaneous displacement current
first_point_contract.verification: Check current components, boundary orientation and Maxwell balance; compare later common samples without hiding the first point and certify starts against an independent derivative/residual reference

conservation_proposal.interval_and_total: Apply the inventory thresholds to every accepted interval and the sum of absolute interval balance defects over each physical phase and whole history; terminal drift alone cannot hide cancellation
conservation_proposal.current_balance_definition: Maximum spread of properly oriented total (conduction plus displacement) current, with the same physical terminal definition; no claim from conduction-current constancy alone
conservation_proposal.controls_gap: Bind actual accepted-step data and a validated residual/current reconstruction before these checks can be executed

metric_contract.zero_denominator: unknown with null value and reason; never filled with zero
metric_contract.weak_forward_power: Propagate independent Pmax uncertainty before accepting a large HI; do not enlarge floors from candidate results
required_acceptance_outputs: both full native J-V branches including negative bias and injection
Voc and bracket/slope on each branch
metric_contract.first_point: Original stored-state current reconstruction omitted index 0 on each branch because its predecessor was not exported; this omission is tagged and does not authorize new solvers to discard first points
metric_contract.PCHIP: 401-point display guides are not new simulations, observations, or accepted sample counts

external_data_needs: No new author Calado data needed for original internal-matrix reproduction. Exact historical source/environment or explicit current-source rebaseline is needed; original Calado paper quantitative match remains outside this task.

freeze_scope.threshold_and_reference_plan_freeze: Requires independent approval of this corrected plan and the already approved numeric limits; does not require already completed physical refinement runs
freeze_scope.qualified_reference_use: Requires actual immutable source/input/environment/initial-state bindings and independently established per-case reference errors, including the executable power predicate
freeze_scope.candidate_acceptance: Requires the frozen contract, qualified reference, eligible candidate identity and all physical/numerical checks; no missing uncertainty may be zero-filled

historical_interval_current.definition: J_cond(t_j) plus signed [D(t_j)-D(t_(j-1))]/(t_j-t_(j-1)); use original 111-point branch intervals for old stored-current comparisons
historical_interval_current.scope: 110 archived current values/branch; the original driver first value was a dwell-interval current, and the archived reconstruction omitted it
historical_interval_current.identity: Explicitly label legacy_interval_endpoint; never compare it silently with instantaneous current

instantaneous_ramp_current.definition: J_cond(t)+signed dD/dt on the requested ramp event side; for this fixed-epsilon HI model, Ddot=epsilon0*epsilon_face*Edot, with Edot from differentiated Poisson using the full charge derivative and the actual boundary voltage derivative
instantaneous_ramp_current.event_rule: Save end-dwell prestate and evaluate the ramp-side derivative at t=0+; a voltage/light discontinuity has event-side and integrated-charge accounting, not a fabricated finite instantaneous impulse value

independent_error_estimate.legacy_to_instantaneous: On a smooth single physical phase, interval quotient bias is bounded by (Delta_t/2)*sup|D_second_time_derivative| plus endpoint/interpolation/Poisson errors; do not apply this across events
independent_error_estimate.instantaneous: Bound differentiated-Poisson residual and RHS/state/dense-derivative errors, crosscheck against a separately refined temporal solution or independent derivative calculation; an ODE state tolerance alone does not bound Ddot
independent_error_estimate.metric_propagation: Propagate qualified current/dense-output errors to bracketed Pmax/Voc and then apply the executable per-case HI power predicate

observable_definitions.history_comparison: Compute both labeled observables from the same qualified future trajectory if needed; historical agreement does not certify instantaneous currents and no observable definition changes inside a comparison
